negative_findings.description: The cell brief named 'Rabota.mk' as a target board. Searches in both mk and en did not surface a live vacancy portal at that domain; search engines instead returned kariera.mk, vraboti.se, apliciraj.mk and the government e-rabota.av.gov.mk. The likely intended source is either e-rabota.av.gov.mk (AVRSM) or a defunct/renamed board.
negative_findings.result_summary: No evidence of an active rabota.mk job board recovered. Not fetched directly, so this is a hypothesis, not a verdict that the domain is dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A named seed source that does not exist would silently create a false sense of coverage; the recall it was meant to provide must be reallocated to kariera.mk / vraboti.se / apliciraj.mk.

negative_findings.description: Targeted searches for MK bank vacancies explicitly naming 'instant payments', 'ISO 20022', SEPA migration or instant-payments project/programme manager roles returned no actual job postings — only macro context (NBRSM/KIBS instant-payment scheme, SEPA ICT accession March 2025) and unrelated Skopje project-manager ads.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero vacancy hits on the highest-value programme keywords via general web search, in both English and Macedonian phrasing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is the single most valuable signal type in the cell. Its absence from search-engine indexes strongly implies such ads exist only inside the boards' own search UIs and bank career pages, where crawler indexing is poor — meaning the collection design must query the portals' internal search directly rather than rely on web search.

negative_findings.description: No settled Macedonian-language vacancy vocabulary was recovered for several core payments concepts: 'ISO 20022' and 'instant payments' appear to be used untranslated or as ad-hoc phrasings ('инстант плаќања', 'итни плаќања'), and no MK-language ad using them was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed mk terms exist and were used successfully for AML ('спречување на перење пари и финансирање тероризам'), payment operations ('одделение за платен промет'), cards ('картично работење'), and payments specialist ('специјалист за плаќања'); no verified mk term set for ISO 20022 / instant payments / fraud / core banking.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Keyword-based collection will systematically under-detect exactly the programme roles the cell exists to find. The glossary must be extended empirically from harvested ad bodies rather than assumed.

negative_findings.description: AVRSM's vacancy search (e-rabota.av.gov.mk/OglasSearch.aspx) is an ASP.NET WebForms page driven by postbacks and ViewState rather than GET parameters, so results are not addressable by URL and are largely invisible to search engines.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search-engine results surfaced only the search form entry point and the user manual PDF, never an individual vacancy record.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The one mandatory-disclosure vacancy register in scope cannot be collected by simple HTTP fetching; budget for headless-browser automation or it will be silently dropped from the pipeline.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn is the only located source that covers leadership moves and title changes for MK banks and PSPs, but its content is login-gated and its ToS forbid automated collection.
negative_findings.result_summary: Company pages (KIBS AD) and a Komercijalna Banka vacancy post were visible in search results, but systematic collection is not permissible by automation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'leadership moves' topic in the run scope has no automatable source in this cell; it must be served by manual analyst review or by a different cell (press releases, NBRSM notifications, trade media).

coverage_gaps.description: No historical archive or time-series of MK job ads was located. Job boards delete expired ads, so a vacancy observed today is unrecoverable in six months, and no backfill baseline exists to say whether current bank hiring is elevated or normal.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Stand up own-archive collection immediately (daily snapshot + hash-dedupe into a local store), and probe the Internet Archive Wayback Machine for historical captures of vrabotuvanje.com.mk category pages and bankarstvo.mk/category/kariera/ to reconstruct a partial baseline.

coverage_gaps.description: Individual career-page URLs were resolved for only one bank (Stopanska Banka). Komercijalna, NLB, Sparkasse, Halkbank, Silk Road, CKB, Kapital, ProCredit, and the PSP/processor set (CaSys, KIBS, Payten/Asseco, Iute) are known as actors but their own career endpoints were not individually pinned down in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated follow-up pass that resolves and registers one career URL per actor, and record for each whether ads are posted on-site, only to boards, or only to LinkedIn — the posting-channel choice is itself intelligence.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell scope covers mk and en, but North Macedonia has a large Albanian-speaking population and banks (notably in Tetovo, Gostivar, Skopje) recruit in Albanian. No Albanian-language job board or Albanian-language vacancy channel was searched or identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the cell with Albanian-language queries ('shpallje pune bankë', 'vend i lirë pune', 'specialist i pagesave') and identify sq-language MK job portals and media; note this may exceed the declared run language scope and needs a scope decision.

coverage_gaps.description: No social-media vacancy channels were investigated. MK employers routinely post ads to Facebook pages and groups, and Telegram/Viber job groups are common; MojaPlata itself surfaced primarily via Facebook in search results.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout MK banking/IT recruiting Facebook pages and groups as a separate discovery task, assessing access and legal status before any collection.

coverage_gaps.description: No structural labour-market denominator for the financial sector was secured — e.g. State Statistical Office (Државен завод за статистика) employment-by-activity series or NBRSM banking-sector headcount reporting — against which vacancy counts could be normalised.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add stat.gov.mk employment-by-NACE-activity and NBRSM banking system reports as companion indirect sources so vacancy volume can be read as a rate rather than a raw count.

coverage_gaps.description: Only two URLs in this slice were actually fetched (bankarstvo.mk article, vrabotuvanje.com.mk banking search). All other URLs come from search-result metadata and are unverified for liveness, and no robots.txt was inspected for any domain.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Let the deterministic liveness pass resolve status codes, and add a robots.txt/ToS review step per domain before enabling automated collection on the commercial boards.

brief: North Macedonia's vacancy landscape for banking and payments is dominated by three general boards — Vrabotuvanje.com.mk (by far the largest, with a usable 'Banking' position filter), Pazar3.mk and KARIERA.mk — flanked by smaller ones (Apliciraj.mk, Vraboti.se, ESI.mk) and by the statutory AVRSM register at e-rabota.av.gov.mk, which is authoritative but locked behind an ASP.NET postback UI. The standout discovery is bankarstvo.mk/category/kariera/, a sector trade site that republishes the vacancy announcements of essentially every MK bank plus processors like CaSys and fintechs like Iute, giving a ready-made, pre-filtered banking vacancy feed; fakulteti.mk, pari.com.mk and the UKIM economics and electrical-engineering faculty pages fill in the vendor- and graduate-recruitment side. Local-language querying was essential and productive for AML, payment-operations and card roles, but produced no hits at all on the highest-value programme keywords (instant payments, ISO 20022), indicating those ads live inside the boards' internal search rather than in web indexes. The two structural weaknesses to plan around are the absence of any historical ad archive — nothing is recoverable once an ad expires, so own-archiving must start on day one — and the fact that leadership moves are only visible on LinkedIn, which cannot be collected automatically.
